use_case: Dynamic pricing tool: machine-learning demand forecasts and daily room rates that publish automatically to the PMS, and from there to the booking engine and 3 OTAs
vendor_or_model: Dynamic pricing tool vendor (machine-learning forecasting and pricing SaaS for small properties)
data_categories: Occupancy, pickup, and rate history from the PMS; public competitor rates; local events calendar. No guest names or contact details
affects_individuals: Yes (prices paid by every guest; not individualized)
consequential_decision_category: None (room prices are not a listed consequential decision); treated as High during a declared state of emergency
human_in_the_loop: Today none: rates publish automatically. Condition of approval: floor, ceiling, and 15% daily change limit with Owner-Manager approval outside them; manual rates capped at the 30-day pre-declaration average during a declared emergency
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 501.160 (unconscionable prices in a declared emergency); 16 CFR 464.2 (total price in every display, including channel feeds); FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. 45(a), (n)); Sherman Act 15 U.S.C. 1 (watch item only; no pooled non-public data)

use_case: AI guest messaging assistant offered by the PMS vendor: would answer guest texts and OTA messages, quote availability and rates, and draft replies
vendor_or_model: PMS vendor add-on (generative AI language model)
data_categories: Would process guest names, phone numbers, messages, and any card numbers guests type; availability and rates from the PMS
human_in_the_loop: Proposed design: staff handoff for booking changes, complaints, accessibility, and emergencies; weekly transcript review
applicable_laws: 16 CFR 464.2 and 464.3; FTC Act Section 5; PCI DSS v4.0.1 (card numbers in chat); Fla. Stat. 501.171 (vendor as third-party agent)
status: Proposed; not approved; must not be enabled without a new assessment (POL-04 4.7)

use_case: Public generative AI chatbots used by staff to draft emails or answer questions
data_categories: Public information only; risk of guest, crew, or card data being pasted
risk_tier: Low (public information only); prohibited for anything else
applicable_laws: POL-04 4.7 and POL-02 C.2 (no Restricted or Internal data); FTC Act Section 5 (accurate statements)
status: Allowed for public information only; prohibited for guest, crew, or card data
